package lessonrelation

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

var supportedRelations = map[string]struct{}{
	domain.LessonRelationImplementation: {},
	domain.LessonRelationPractice:       {},
	domain.LessonRelationComparison:     {},
	domain.LessonRelationReference:      {},
	domain.LessonRelationPrerequisite:   {},
	domain.LessonRelationContinuation:   {},
	domain.LessonRelationSeeAlso:        {},
}

// ReplaceLessonRelations atomically reconciles every outgoing relation owned by one lesson.
type ReplaceLessonRelations struct {
	Lessons   repository.LessonRepository
	Relations repository.LessonRelationRepository
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc ReplaceLessonRelations) Handle(ctx context.Context, sourceLessonID string, relations []domain.LessonRelation) error {
	sourceLessonID, err := normalizeID(sourceLessonID)
	if err != nil || uc.Lessons == nil || uc.Relations == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := normalizeRelations(sourceLessonID, relations)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	run := func(fn func(context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, sourceLessonID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, relation := range normalized {
			if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, relation.TargetLessonID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return uc.Relations.ReplaceBySourceLesson(ctx, sourceLessonID, normalized)
	})
}

// ListLessonRelations returns outgoing semantic relations for one lesson.
type ListLessonRelations struct {
	Lessons   repository.LessonRepository
	Relations repository.LessonRelationRepository
}

func (uc ListLessonRelations) Handle(ctx context.Context, sourceLessonID string) ([]domain.LessonRelation, error) {
	sourceLessonID, err := normalizeID(sourceLessonID)
	if err != nil || uc.Lessons == nil || uc.Relations == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, sourceLessonID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return uc.Relations.ListBySourceLesson(ctx, sourceLessonID)
}

// DeleteLessonRelation removes one semantic relation by ID.
type DeleteLessonRelation struct {
	Relations repository.LessonRelationRepository
}

func (uc DeleteLessonRelation) Handle(ctx context.Context, relationID string) error {
	relationID, err := normalizeID(relationID)
	if err != nil || uc.Relations == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return uc.Relations.Delete(ctx, relationID)
}

func normalizeRelations(sourceLessonID string, relations []domain.LessonRelation) ([]domain.LessonRelation, error) {
	result := make([]domain.LessonRelation, 0, len(relations))
	sourceKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(relations))
	identities := make(map[string]struct{}, len(relations))
	for _, relation := range relations {
		if relation.ID == "" {
			relation.ID = uuid.NewString()
		} else {
			var err error
			relation.ID, err = normalizeID(relation.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
		}
		var err error
		relation.SourceKey, err = domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(relation.SourceKey)
		if err != nil || relation.SourceKey == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := sourceKeys[relation.SourceKey]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate lesson relation source_key", domain.ErrConflict)
		}
		sourceKeys[relation.SourceKey] = struct{}{}

		relation.SourceLessonID = sourceLessonID
		relation.TargetLessonID, err = normalizeID(relation.TargetLessonID)
		if err != nil || relation.TargetLessonID == sourceLessonID {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		relation.Relation = strings.TrimSpace(relation.Relation)
		if _, ok := supportedRelations[relation.Relation]; !ok {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		identity := relation.TargetLessonID + "\x00" + relation.Relation
		if _, exists := identities[identity]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate semantic lesson relation", domain.ErrConflict)
		}
		identities[identity] = struct{}{}

		relation.Stacks, err = normalizeLabels(relation.Stacks, false)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		relation.Concepts, err = normalizeLabels(relation.Concepts, true)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if relation.PrimaryStack != nil {
			primary := strings.TrimSpace(*relation.PrimaryStack)
			if primary == "" || len(primary) > 128 || !contains(relation.Stacks, primary) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			relation.PrimaryStack = &primary
		}
		result = append(result, relation)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeID(value string) (string, error) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(value); err != nil {
		return "", domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return value, nil
}

func normalizeLabels(values []string, required bool) ([]string, error) {
	if required && len(values) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if value == "" || len(value) > 128 {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func contains(values []string, target string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == target {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
